method: All seven complete originating sections were read in canonical order. Each recorded subsection was then compared with the complete, actually read candidate paragraphs named below, in both schools, with surrounding context checked where needed. Candidate retrieval and targeted phrase searches served only as discovery aids. The assessments report these finite comparisons, not the absence of every possible connection. New English translates unchanged contiguous canonical excerpts. No canonical body or footnote was rewritten.
